Security Forces Conduct Searches in Multiple Jammu and Kashmir Districts

Security forces have launched search operations in the Udhampur, Reasi, and Kathua districts of Jammu and Kashmir. These operations were initiated following reports of suspicious movement of individuals in these areas. The searches are currently underway across multiple locations within these districts.
